capture.zh: 在海盗能源站挑战斯宾塞，打败后获得斯宾塞精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 厄尔塞拉金光闪烁消强化；布林克克、布鲁克克各用5次以上海洋之心（百分比伤害不受1点限制）；降到1/5以下后用厄尔塞拉造成烧伤使护盾失效，最后谱尼圣灵魔闪光收尾。

engine_notes: Signature mechanic (很难受到伤害): every physical or special attack deals exactly 1 damage. Percentage damage (海洋之心) and status damage are not capped.

damage_cap_breaks_on_dot: while the boss is burned/frozen/poisoned the 1-damage shield 'has a high chance to disappear' (4399: 有很大机率会消失); chance 80 is an estimate — model as a per-hit roll while the boss has a DoT status.
Innate boost exists (天生有强化，可消掉) but which stat is not stated; atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19). It CAN be cleared.
Below 1/5 HP every boss attack is a critical hit (always_crit).
Control/weaken skills 'basically ineffective' (同生共死、寄生种子、控场技能、弱化技能基本无效).
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2011-10-08; 黑暗撕裂 = catalog 暗黑撕裂) and equal species 945's last four at or below Lv80.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 SPT page 2011-10-08: 80级, 5000血左右; 物攻/特攻只减1滴血; 掉血状态下特效大概率消失; 1/5血以下每次致命一击.
